51742-the-wyandotte-convention-an-addres.title: The Wyandotte Convention An Address
51742-the-wyandotte-convention-an-addres.creator: Unknown
51742-the-wyandotte-convention-an-addres.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. , and after a session of four days, adjourned until the 19th of October, a final adjournment being reached on the 3d of November. It was composed of sixty-four members, forty-five of whom signed the organic law it framed, and its session continued twenty days. No direct vote on this Constitution was provided for.

a-practical-directory-for-young-christia.title: A practical directory for young Christian females
a-practical-directory-for-young-christia.creator: Harvey Newcomb

arxiv-1803-05252.title: Algebraic Machine Learning
arxiv-1803-05252.creator: Fernando Martin-Maroto, Gonzalo G. de Polavieja
arxiv-1803-05252.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Fernando Martin-Maroto, Gonzalo G. de Polavieja. Machine learning algorithms use error function minimization to fit a large set of parameters in a preexisting model. However, error minimization eventually leads to a memorization of the training dataset, losing the ability to generalize to other datasets. To achieve generalization something else is needed, for example a regularization method or stopping the training when error in a validation dataset is minimal.

arxiv-2103-16803.title: Localization-delocalization effects of a delocalizing dissipation on disordered XXZ spin chains
arxiv-2103-16803.creator: Xiansong Xu, Dario Poletti
arxiv-2103-16803.description: Abstract The interplay between interaction, disorder, and dissipation has shown a rich phenomenology. Here we investigate a disordered XXZ spin chain in contact with a bath which, alone, would drive the system towards a highly delocalized and coherent Dicke state.

arxiv-2106-03138.title: Deviation Maximization for Rank-Revealing QR Factorizations
arxiv-2106-03138.creator: Monica Dessole, Fabio Marcuzzi
arxiv-2106-03138.description: Abstract In this paper we introduce a new column selection strategy, named here “Deviation Maximization”, and apply it to compute rank-revealing QR factorizations as an alternative to the well known block version of the QR factorization with the column pivoting method, called QP3 and currently implemented in LAPACK’s xgeqp3 routine.

arxiv-2209-13412.title: InSight Pressure Data Recalibration, and its Application to the Study of Long-Term Pressure Changes on Mars
arxiv-2209-13412.description: Abstract Observations of the South Polar Residual Cap suggest a possible erosion of the cap, leading to an increase of the global mass of the atmosphere. We test this assumption by making the first comparison between Viking 1 and InSight surface pressure data, which were recorded 40 years apart.

arxiv-2309-09429.title: Quantum mechanical Gaussian wavepackets of single relativistic particles
arxiv-2309-09429.creator: Yu-Che Huang, Fong-Ming He, Shih-Yuin Lin
arxiv-2309-09429.description: Abstract We study the evolutions of selected quasi-(1+1) dimensional wavepacket solutions to the Klein-Gordon equation for a relativistic charged particle in uniform motion or accelerated by a uniform electric field in Minkowski space. We explore how good the charge density of a Klein-Gordon wavepacket can be approximately described by a Gaussian state with the single-particle interpretation.

arxiv-2311-18806.title: Efficient Baseline for Quantitative Precipitation Forecasting in Weather4cast 2023
arxiv-2311-18806.creator: Akshay Punjabi, Pablo Izquierdo Ayala
arxiv-2311-18806.description: Abstract Accurate precipitation forecasting is indispensable for informed decision-making across various industries. However, the computational demands of current models raise environmental concerns. We address the critical need for accurate precipitation forecasting while considering the environmental impact of computational resources and propose a minimalist U-Net architecture to be used as a baseline for future weather forecasting initiatives.

arxiv-2403-06421.title: A comparative study of perceptual quality metrics for audio-driven talking head videos
arxiv-2403-06421.creator: Weixia Zhang, Chengguang Zhu, Jingnan Gao, Yichao Yan, Guangtao Zhai, Xiaokang Yang
arxiv-2403-06421.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) technology has propelled audio-driven talking head generation, gaining considerable research attention for practical applications. However, performance evaluation research lags behind the development of talking head generation techniques. Existing literature relies on heuristic quantitative metrics without human validation, hindering accurate progress assessment.

arxiv-2405-01512.description: Abstract . Let π \pi be an irreducible cuspidal automorphic representation of GL n ​ ( 𝔸 ℚ ) \mathrm{GL}_{n}(\mathbb{A}_{\mathbb{Q}}) with associated L L -function L ⁡ ( s , π ) L(s,\pi) . We study the behaviour of the partial Euler product of L ⁡ ( s , π ) L(s,\pi) at the center of the critical strip.

arxiv-2503-00840.title: Incompatibility of rank-one POVMs and quantum uncertainty relations
arxiv-2503-00840.creator: Xu Wang, Weisong Dong, Pan Lian
arxiv-2503-00840.description: Abstract . The incompatibility of quantum measurements is a fundamental feature of quantum mechanics with profound implications for uncertainty relations and quantum information processing. In this paper, we extend the notion of s s -order incompatibility of measurements, introduced by Xu (inspired by De Bièvre’s “complete incompatibility” ), to more general rank-one POVMs, and establish novel uncertainty relations.

arxiv-2509-26091.title: Text-to-Scene with Large Reasoning Models
arxiv-2509-26091.creator: Frédéric Berdoz, Luca A. Lanzendörfer, Nick Tuninga, Roger Wattenhofer
arxiv-2509-26091.description: Abstract Prompt-driven scene synthesis allows users to generate complete 3D environments from textual descriptions. Current text-to-scene methods often struggle with complex geometries and object transformations, and tend to show weak adherence to complex instructions. We address these limitations by introducing Reason-3D, a text-to-scene model powered by large reasoning models (LRMs).

doe-osti-3002237-initial-design-curves-f.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. doe-osti-3005423-implementation-of-johns.creator: Sweeney, Daniel C., Reed, F. Kyle, Ezell, N. Dianne Bull
doe-osti-3005423-implementation-of-johns.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The random motion of charge carriers in an electrical conductor is a function of its temperature. This phenomenon generates an electrical signal, referred to as Johnson noise, that is present in all analog signals. Conversely, the temperature dependence of the Johnson noise spect

pmc-10538095.title: A Fatal A/H5N1 Avian Influenza Virus Infection in a Cat in Poland
pmc-10538095.creator: Olga Szaluś-Jordanow, Anna Golke, Tomasz Dzieciątkowski, Dorota Chrobak-Chmiel, Magdalena Rzewuska, Michał Czopowicz, Rafał Sapierzyński, Michał Kardas, Kinga Biernacka, Marcin Mickiewicz, Agata Moroz-Fik, Andrzej Łobaczewski, Ilona Stefańska, Ewelina Kwiecień, Iwona Markowska-Daniel, Tadeusz Frymus
pmc-10538095.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A European Shorthair male cat, neutered, approximately 6 years of age, was presented to the veterinary clinic due to apathy and anorexia. The cat lived mostly outdoors and was fed raw chicken meat. After 3 days of diagnostic procedures and symptomatic treatment, respiratory distress and neurological signs developed and progressed into epileptic seizures, followed by respiratory and cardiac arrest within the next 3 days. Post-mortem examination revealed necrotic lesions in the liver, lungs, and intestines.

pmc-10738138.title: IS LONELINESS CONTAGIOUS? AN ECOLOGICAL MOMENTARY ASSESSMENT WITHIN ROMANTIC COUPLES
pmc-10738138.creator: Martina Luchetti, Fiona Rupprecht, Jana Nikitin, Alyssa Gamaldo, Jacqueline Mogle, Thomas Ledermann, Martin Sliwinski, Angelina Sutin
pmc-10738138.description: Although marriage has been found to be protective against feeling lonely, loneliness might also be ‘contagious’ and spread from one individual to another, particularly within close relationships. Feelings of loneliness tend to correlate within spouses and are associated with relationship strain and lower perceived support from the partner.

pmc-11397709.title: The Impact of Japanese Dietary Patterns on Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and Liver Fibrosis
pmc-11397709.creator: Takafumi Sasada, Chikara Iino, Satoshi Sato, Tetsuyuki Tateda, Go Igarashi, Kenta Yoshida, Kaori Sawada, Tatsuya Mikami, Shigeyuki Nakaji, Hirotake Sakuraba, Shinsaku Fukuda, Lili Yang
pmc-11397709.description: This study aimed to investigate the effect of Japanese dietary patterns on metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) and liver fibrosis. After excluding factors affecting the diagnosis of hepatic steatosis, 727 adults were analyzed as part of the Health Promotion Project.

pmc-11447165.title: Tumor immunogenicity regulates host immune responses, and conventional dendritic cell type 2 uptakes the majority of tumor antigens in an orthotopic lung cancer model
pmc-11447165.creator: Ki-Hyun Kim, Seung-jae Kim, Jacob D Eccles, Christian Ascoli, Gye Young Park
pmc-11447165.description: Human lung cancer carries high genetic alterations, expressing high tumor-specific neoantigens. Although orthotopic murine lung cancer models recapitulate many characteristics of human lung cancers, genetically engineered mouse models have fewer somatic mutations than human lung cancer, resulting in scarce immune cell infiltration and deficient immune responses.

pmc-11458046.title: Impact of macroeconomic indicators and regime change on debt stress in Zambia
pmc-11458046.creator: Joseph Phiri, Veronica Chimuka Choolwe, Peter Kondwani Phiri, Michael Chanda Chiseni, Briven Muchanga Simaundu, Evans Osabuohien
pmc-11458046.description: This paper quantifies the economic impact of regime changes and macroeconomic indicators on debt stress in Zambia using the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) Bounds test. A 1% short run increase in gross domestic products (GDP) increases debt stress by 3.16% and in the subsequent year lowers it by 7.

pmc-11478624.title: Association of Fast-Food Intake with Depressive and Anxiety Symptoms among Young Adults: A Pilot Study
pmc-11478624.creator: Wai-Kin Tang, Jetty Chung-Yung Lee
pmc-11478624.description: Background: High intake of fast food has been linked to increased risks of both depressive and anxiety disorders. However, associations between individual fast-food items and depressive/anxiety disorders are rarely examined. Method: Using cross-sectional survey the association between common fast-food items and depressive/anxiety symptoms among 142 young Hong Kong adults aged 18–27 years old was examined.

pmc-11736362.title: Identification of veterinary and medically important blood parasites using contrastive loss-based self-supervised learning
pmc-11736362.creator: Supasuta Busayakanon, Morakot Kaewthamasorn, Natchapon Pinetsuksai, Teerawat Tongloy, Santhad Chuwongin, Siridech Boonsang, Veerayuth Kittichai
pmc-11736362.description: Background and Aim:Zoonotic diseases caused by various blood parasites are important public health concerns that impact animals and humans worldwide. The traditional method of microscopic examination for parasite diagnosis is labor-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to variability among observers, necessitating highly skilled and experienced personnel. Therefore, an innovative approach is required to enhance the conventional method.

pmc-12447328.title: TAOK2 drives opposing cilia length deficits in 16p11.2 deletion and duplication carriers
pmc-12447328.creator: Sujin Byeon, Amy Ferreccio, Moira Cornell, Juan A Oses-Prieto, Aditi Deshpande, Siri Manvi, Alison Blencowe, Lauren A Weiss, Alma L Burlingame, Smita Yadav
pmc-12447328.description: SummaryDeletion and duplication of the 16p11.2 genomic locus are associated with opposing changes in brain size. To determine cellular mechanisms that underlie these opposing phenotypes, we performed quantitative phosphoproteomic analyses of induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs)-derived neural progenitor cells (NPCs) obtained from unaffected individuals, 16p11.2 deletion, and 16p11.2 duplication carriers. Differentially phosphorylated proteins were enriched in centrosomal and cilia proteins.

pmc-12697183.title: Phages infecting Clostridium sporogenes
pmc-12697183.creator: Joanna P. Steczynska, Kaleb W. Jackson, Kelly P. Williams
pmc-12697183.description: Clostridium sporogenes is a spore-forming anaerobe found ubiquitously in the environment associated with food spoilage. It is also a gut commensal. We report isolation of phages able to infect C. sporogenes, with 30 unique genomes falling into three congeneric species. ANNOUNCEMENT Clostridium sporogenes is a common human gut commensal and is associated with food spoilage.

pmc-13183713.title: Stigmergic influence of simple bots on human cooperation in digital environments
pmc-13183713.creator: Thomas Bassanetti, Stéphane Cezera, Maxime Delacroix, Ramón Escobedo, Adrien Blanchet, Clément Sire, Guy Theraulaz
pmc-13183713.description: In the digital era, human cooperation is increasingly mediated by indirect social cues such as ratings, reviews, and other digital traces left in online environments. These traces often guide collective behavior via stigmergy, a coordination mechanism whereby individuals interact through modifications of a shared environment.

pmc-13188392.title: Incidence of late onset bloodstream infections and use of preventive practices in very low birth weight infants in Spain: the NeoKissEs cohort surveillance experience
pmc-13188392.creator: Jose I Pijoan, Javier Pérez-López, Marisela Madrid, Carmen Ribes, Fátima Camba, Brar Piening, Begoña Loureiro
pmc-13188392.description: BackgroundBloodstream infections (BSI), especially central line associated BSI (CLABSI) are common severe healthcare associated infections (HAI) in very low birth weight (VLBW) neonates (< 1500 g at birth) admitted to neonatal intensive care units (NICUs). However, surveillance systems are known to contribute to reducing HAI.

pmc-13276693.title: Autistic Children With Speech Onset Delay Show Reversed Bias in Spectral Versus Temporal Auditory Processing
pmc-13276693.creator: Luodi Yu, Shuyu Xie, Li Wang, Laurent Mottron
pmc-13276693.description: A recent “hierarchical” reinterpretation of the neurological basis of autism suggests that in autism with early language delay, perceptual processing may be favored over the integration of transmodal information. This model is largely based on neuroimaging findings relating to visual processing, but predicts a corresponding reorganization in the auditory modality.

pmc-13299908.title: Subclinical atrial fibrillation and the risk of heart failure: insights from ARTESiA
pmc-13299908.creator: M H J Frausing, W F Mcintyre, J S Healey, T Kovalova, J A Wong, S Z Diederichsen, L Y Xing, C B Granger, R D Lopes, A P Benz, J W Erath, G Boriani, A E Albertsen, K F Holm, J C Nielsen
pmc-13299908.description: BackgroundSubclinical atrial fibrillation (SCAF) is a common finding in patients with a pacemaker, defibrillator or implantable cardiac monitor. Heart failure (HF) and clinical atrial fibrillation are closely linked, but the relationship between device-detected SCAF and HF is unclear.PurposeWe aimed to determine incidence and clinical risk factors for HF events among patients with SCAF.

pmc-13315680.title: Integrative genomic and transcriptomic analysis to identify potential candidate genes influencing plumage color variation in mule ducks
pmc-13315680.creator: Hongxiang Liu, Yifei Wang, Shiheng Zhou, Wei Zhou, Huiqing Zhu, Zhicheng Wang, Weitao Song, Zhiyun Tao, Wenjuan Xu, Haotian Gu, Shuangjie Zhang, Huifang Li, Chunhong Zhu
pmc-13315680.description: Plumage color is a distinctive and economically important trait in poultry; however, its genetic architecture in hybrid species, such as the mule duck, remains poorly characterized. Traditional mapping approaches often fail to accurately establish causal genes, particularly for traits likely governed by major-effect loci.

pmc-13556500.title: 419. A high-throughput screening platform for the discovery of selective M1/M4 muscarinic receptor agonists and positive allosteric modulators
pmc-13556500.creator: Z Yan, Y Zhang, H Tan, J Zhu, S Cui
pmc-13556500.description: BackgroundThe M1 and M4 subtypes of muscarinic acetylcholine receptors (mAChRs) are compelling therapeutic targets for psychiatric disorders, as evidenced by the recent FDA approval of the M1/M4-preferring agonist xanomeline for schizophrenia. Achieving subtype selectivity is essential to obtain the procognitive and antipsychotic benefits of M1/M4 activation while minimize peripheral side effects mediated by M2/M3 receptors.

uslaw-usc-t26-s5392.title: 26 U.S.C. § 5392 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t26-s5392.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s5392.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 51 (Distilled Spirits, Wines, And Beer); Subchapter F (Bonded And Taxpaid Wine Premises); Part IV (General). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Standard wine For purposes of this subchapter the term “standard wine” means natural wine, specially sweetened natural wine, special natural wine, and standard agricultural wine, produced in accordance with the provisions.
